header:
template<typename P>
inline uint2 ld2(P p) { return uint2(p[0], p[1]); }
idea: Each lane loads 16 weights per row as one 8-byte uint2 and uses masked nibbles against x pre-scaled by 16^-i, which removes the per-element shifts. This halves the loop trips and the scale/bias loads, and x and the group sum are still shared across 4 rows.
